Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. As we move toward our procurement checklist I wanted to consolidate the SIG follow-up items and confirm a single location where Blue Horizon can pull the evidence. Our security team needs the following to complete the SIG + internal review: 

1) Current security policy (infosec and acceptable use) and change history (PDF preferred)
2) A network architecture diagram that shows VPC peering, ingress/egress controls, and service isolation (PNG or PDF)
3) KMS/key management runbook or playbook describing key rotation, access controls, and HSM/KMS provider (markdown or PDF)
4) Screenshots or session recordings showing the admin console for RBAC configuration and user provisioning (annotated preferred)
5) Any runbooks describing incident response for suspected data exfiltration
6) A short manifest (CSV or spreadsheet) listing filenames, last-modified dates, and owners for the items above

Can you confirm target delivery by next Tuesday (Apr 27)? Also let us know if anything requires an NDA or redaction before we ingest it into our SIG tracker.

Alex
